prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-photorealistic neo-Victorian coquette portrait in a warm cream interior.
prompt.main_subject: Clearly adult fictional woman with long voluminous waves, dewy realistic skin, white graphic liner, defined lashes, high-neck Victorian blouse with puff sleeves and silk bows, structured white corset worn over the blouse, pleated skirt with secure opaque coverage, and opaque white stockings with floral lace bands.
prompt.composition_elements: Medium full-shot at eye level, seated gracefully on a ledge with one leg elevated naturally, classic white tiled stove or fireplace, cream striped wallpaper, framed floral painting and warm wooden floor.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused indoor light, gentle satin highlights, bounce from white tiles, monochromatic white and cream with warm wood and gold accents.
prompt.technical_specs: 35mm wide-angle lens, f/2.8, RAW photorealism, 8K detail, fabric, skin and fireplace texture, no text or logos.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-photorealistic neo-Victorian coquette fashion portrait of a clearly adult fictional woman with long voluminous waves, dewy skin, white graphic liner and defined lashes, wearing a high-neck Victorian blouse with puff sleeves and silk bows, structured white corset over the blouse, pleated skirt with secure opaque coverage and opaque white stockings with floral lace bands, seated gracefully on a ledge in a cream fireplace interior, soft diffused light, 35mm f/2.8, no text.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sheer stockings, exposed intimate areas, sexualized pose, child, teen, ageless person, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, plastic skin, watermark, logo, text, extra fingers, deformed
